about: Measured results shown on the landing page. Every number is copied from the lab notebook; each entry's quotes are the passages of the notebook it was copied from, word for word. `npm run sync` checks that every quote is still in the notebook. Runs the notebook lists as in progress are not included.

conventions.text: Success is closed-loop, on layouts the policy never saw, with one training seed per run; intervals are Wilson 95% intervals. Differences of a few percent between single runs are noise.
quotes: All success rates are closed-loop on layouts the policy never saw
one training seed per run, Wilson 95% intervals
Differences of a few percent between single runs are noise

The two 200-demonstration runs share task, data and training budget: the policy given one pooled vector per image has the lower loss and the lower success, and scored 0/20 even on its own training layouts. One pooled vector is not enough for grasping.

findings.title: Looking at the scene arrives late and all at once
findings.setting: pick_target, 4000 demonstrations, one policy evaluated as it trains (averaged weights), 100 unseen layouts

note.text: The 36M-parameter policy with instruction tokens and no history. It stays at 2% or less for the first 1.5M samples, then covers most of the way within the next million; the final checkpoint scored 83/100 on a second set of layouts. With 1500 demonstrations and 1.0M samples the same policy ends at 5%, so a budget that ends too early reads as a design that does not work.
quotes: A second set of 100 layouts (seeds 1,000,100-1,000,199), same checkpoint: 83/100
`dp_vit_lang_reactive`: language, no history | 1500 | 1.0M | 3% / 5%
All policies in this section are the 36M-parameter one
**Machine A** has one 24 GB GPU
## The from-scratch stages (machine A unless noted)

items.result: Loss 6.3 to 4.1; it writes grammatical English.
quotes: 12 layers, 8 heads, 512 wide, vocabulary 49,280, 91.4M parameters
61,000 DCLM-baseline web documents
